args.body:
- Apparel return rates reached 24%, making returns a major cost driver in retail logistics.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth (~20%).
- Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the original margin.

Sources: https://blog.brightline.example/2026/returns and its companion piece at https://insights.brightline.example/returns/companion
args.title: Retail Returns: Brightline 2026 Summary
